# LegacyStack

> LegacyStack is an immutable borrowing protocol on Ethereum: a fixed 1.5% a year credit line against staked ether (wstETH), with succession built into the vault. No admin keys, no governance over positions, no middleman. OCT is its loan unit, never a stablecoin.

Status: test deployment on the Sepolia test network, unaudited code; nothing here has value. The frontend does not serve persons in the United States.

## Read first

- [Protocol brief for agents and integrators](https://plslend.github.io/legacystack-core/agent.md): what it is, what can never change, the numbers, the risks in order, how to use it safely
- [Machine-readable protocol data](https://plslend.github.io/legacystack-core/.well-known/legacystack.json): constants, invariants, current addresses, risk statements
- [Deployment addresses](https://plslend.github.io/legacystack-core/deployment.json): every contract of the current deployment
- [The playbook: hold, borrow, pass it on](https://plslend.github.io/legacystack-core/playbook.html): the private-bank strategy in protocol terms, with the rules a careful user or agent can adopt
